title: Keep it safe
headline: Keep it *safe*
sub: Mute, About, block, who sees your name, and your account.

recap.en: Messages, orders, groups. How do you keep it safe?
recap.pcm: Messages, orders, groups. How you go keep am safe?

closing.en: That is Taskiem for you, beside the chats you already have. Talk to a business on Taskiem.
closing.pcm: Na so Taskiem for you be, beside the chats wey you don get. Talk to a business on Taskiem.

flow.action: Frowns at his phone, sets it face-down on the arm of the sofa, then takes a breath and relaxes
flow.setting: Tobi's living room in a Lagos flat: a sofa, a small table, a window on the street, soft evening light

flow.action: Looks up from her phone to Tobi, nods once with a satisfied smile and taps her phone screen with one finger
flow.setting: Mama Tobi's front room in Surulere, Lagos: a floral sofa, a framed family photo, a ceiling fan, warm afternoon light

en: A message you do not like? Open the chat.
Taskiem keeps chats on its servers. They are not end-to-end encrypted.
To stop them writing, tap Block.
They are not told. You can unblock later.
Back on Chats, tap More, then Settings.
Blocked people lists who you blocked.
Privacy shows what a business sees: your name and number.
Delete your account is at the bottom of Settings.
It says what goes and what businesses keep.
pcm: Message wey you no like? Open the chat.
